reference_state: Area/time mean over primary 1024-step fixed geographical domain, using actual above-ground valid observations per pressure; shared by both events and shifted-input sensitivity
fixed_column_mask: Each pressure/grid column above actual surface and finite u/v/T/Phi throughout union1088; omega also finite at three supplied levels. No zero fill/extrapolation.
reference_missing_rule: Preserve actual13-level reference and neighboring derivatives. Missing/unstable levels masked individually; valid common-pressure diagnostics retained.
space_weights: Exact spherical grid-cell areas; geographic derivatives before neighborhood sampling
pre_window_support: At least3 of4 identical pre-departure offsets in both SID members; mean paired difference over exactly those common offsets
scope: Storage, same-scale conversion, horizontal transport, horizontal canonical-transfer contributions and boundary net vertical inputs are distinct; no complete budget or complete3D canonical transfer

MWT.implementation: Unchanged supplied MWT basis applied through a validated exact linear operator
MWT.main_start: 6-hour-UTC-floored midpoint of frozen two departure times minus 512 steps
MWT.sensitivity: Same N shifted forward 64 steps (16 days); same scales, geographical domain, reference state, fixed column mask

fixed_geographical_domain: Smallest supplied 0.25-degree rectangle containing both events observed centres -24 through +24h plus800-km circles and2grid-cell halo; longitude unwrapped about SID
period_relation: P_j = 2 * N * dt_seconds / 2**j; nominal window boundary, not a sharp Fourier band
